_note: Draft IMD job. Field names follow the IMD worker's TaskDescriptor / LotusJobRequest schemas; map them onto the public paid-posting API when it opens. `guidance` = skills/fix/SKILL.md without its YAML front matter. <COMMIT> = the round's commit in this repository. <ID>, <TITLE>, <PATHS> come from ledger/ledger.json; list every source file the fix may touch in allowedPaths.
objective: 🐸 Fren Review FIX <ID> — close a proven vulnerability in the Magic Internet Frens Cauldron: <TITLE>. Its PoC is in test/fren-review/<ID>/. Follow the FIX procedure in skills/fix/SKILL.md: name the root cause as a broken invariant, search for variants of the same pattern, make the smallest change that closes the root cause, flip the PoC into a regression test that asserts the safe outcome (plus the variants, keeping the control), keep storage layouts append-only and every contract under the 24,576-byte runtime limit, and say how the fix would reach a live deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: The change is confined to the listed source files and test/fren-review/<ID>/, and changes nothing unrelated to the root cause; no existing test is deleted or weakened.
The PoC in test/fren-review/<ID>/ now asserts the safe outcome and would fail if the vulnerability returned; variants the fix must cover are tested too.

forge build and forge test pass, `forge build --sizes` shows every contract's runtime code under 24,576 bytes, and no existing storage slot moved (forge inspect <Contract> storageLayout before and after).
The final message starts with `FREN-REVIEW FIX <ID>: fixed` or `FREN-REVIEW FIX <ID>: cannot-fix`, followed by the root cause, what changed, the variants checked, and the size and layout results.
No transaction is sent to any live network and no private key is used.
